name: skillmeter
description: Live SkillBench telemetry for Codex — lifecycle-hook session analytics, plus sanitized export and review skills.

interface.shortDescription: Live SkillBench telemetry for Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: SkillMeter records anonymized Codex lifecycle telemetry (sessions, prompts, tool use, subagents) and forwards it to the SkillBench analyzer alongside Claude Code and GitHub data. Telemetry is opt-in per project with path hashing and repo-scope filtering. Bundled skills also collect, scope-check, and review sanitized exports.
defaultPrompt: Enable SkillMeter telemetry for this project and show the current status.
Use SkillMeter to check whether this repo matches my allowed GitHub org scope.
Use SkillMeter to review this sanitized export before I upload it.
